items.item:
- DEP-002: the pre-deploy vulnerability check of those pins passes: the deploy
  step judges every distribution installed in the built image, bound to its
  content id, against a fresh public advisory snapshot, and starts the
  service only on a recent passing verdict about that same image; a listed
  version, stale, missing or unmatchable data, or another image does not
  start it [witness: verification:dependency_release_gate_client_portal].
statements:
DEP-002: no deploy ships a pin with a known vulnerability affecting the
  portal.

quotes: assert [(f["package"], f["version"]) for f in report["findings"]] == [("starlette", "0.36.3")]
assert report["coverage"]["declared"] == "every distribution installed in the built image"
verdicts.why: The tests detect vulnerable direct and transitive installed distributions, incomplete or unmatchable advisory evidence, stale or missing evidence, and image/content-ID changes. They also exercise the deploy entrypoint to prove that only a recent passing verdict for the exact inspected image permits switching, while vulnerable, unreadable, stale, missing, or different-image cases refuse startup.
